description:
Cast Dunland Crebain by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Dunland Crebain enters, it creates a creature token with mutiple counters on it, including a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing two vigilance counters and one additional counter from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dunland Crebain and one additional creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Dunland Crebain from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
